title: Vietnam Couple EXCLUSIVE | FREE Candle Light Dinner
highlights: Explore Vietnam as you immerse yourself in Hanoi's charm, cruise through Halong Bay, and experience the vibrant life of Ho Chi Minh City.
Visit Ninh Binh's ancient temples and enjoy a boat ride through Tam Coc, known as "Halong Bay on Land".
Cruise through the emerald waters of Halong Bay, marvelling at the limestone formations and visiting various attractions.
Learn about Vietnam's wartime history at the Cu Chi Tunnels, a vast underground network used as a hiding spot during the war.
overview:
About the tour:
Visit Vietnam, a land of breathtaking landscapes, vibrant culture, and a rich history, making it one of the top destinations in Southeast Asia. Explore Ho Chi Minh City, where colonial architecture blends with bustling markets and lively walking streets. It's no surprise that Vietnam honeymoon packages often include this vibrant city, as it offers something for everyone. Experience the tranquil beauty of Ha Long Bay, cruising past its iconic limestone cliffs and emerald waters. Immerse yourself in the country's deep history through visits to war memorials and museums that reflect Vietnam's resilient spirit.


This tour offers the perfect mix of adventure and relaxation, with opportunities to cruise along picturesque islands, savor authentic Vietnamese cuisine, interact with welcoming locals, and shop at bustling markets. From exploring ancient temples and historical landmarks to enjoying vibrant city life, this Vietnam travel package promises a memorable journey for you and your loved ones.

know_before_you_go: Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.

ID Proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of bookingg, and upon arrival. PAN Card will not be considered as a valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Images are only for representation purposes.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.

As per Government of India’s rules, a Tax Collection at Source (TCS) of 5% for Foreign Remittance shall be paid additionally that you can claim while filing the income tax returns. Consult a tax advisor/consultant for further information.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Hanoi! Upon arrival at the Noi Bai International Airport, you will be transferred to the hotel. Check in and spend the rest of the day at leisure exploring various attractions in the capital city, Hanoi. You can visit Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, Huc Bridge, and Ngoc Son Temple Hanoi, among other attractions. Later, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Hm Boutique Hotel Hanoi at 02:00 PM

days.title: Day Trip to Ninh Binh
days.desc: In the morning, you'll get transferred to Hoa Lu in Ninh Binh district. Explore the ancient temples of the Le and Dinh Dynasties, marveling at their well-preserved architecture. After immersing yourself in the rich heritage, embark on a serene boat trip through Tam Coc. As you glide through the tranquil waters, witness stunning limestone formations, lush rice paddies and beautiful caves. Afterward, get driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Halong Bay | Overnight Cruise
days.desc: Post check out from your hotel, get driven through scenic routes to Tuan Chau Marina. Upon your arrival, board a traditional sailing cruise, check in and enjoy the beautiful views of floating villages and limestone formations. Enjoy various entertainment options and engage in activities such as kayaking through the calm, clear waters or swimming in the bay’s refreshing depths. Afterward, return to your cabin for a comfortable overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Ho Chi Minh City via Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Wake up early to witness a beautiful sunrise over Halong Bay. Enjoy breakfast and go on a boat ride to the Surprise Cave, the largest cave in Halong Bay and admire its scenic beauty. Then, deboard the cruise and get transferred to Hanoi for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Upon arrival, get transferred from the Tan Son Nhat International Airport to the hotel for check in. Spend the rest of the day at your leisure exploring various attractions, and later having an overnight stay at the hotel.

days.title: Visit to Cu Chi Tunnels | Ho Chi Minh City Tour
days.desc: Today, get driven to Cu Chi Tunnels, an extensive network of underground passages used during the Vietnam War. Next, get transferred for a half-day tour of Ho Chi Minh City. Visit the Presidential Palace, a historical building that was once the residence of South Vietnam's president. Explore the War Remnants Museum, and marvel at the Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica, a beautiful French colonial architecture. Visit the Central Post Office, before getting driven back to your hotel.

days.desc: On this day, get ready to go on the Mekong Delta tour. Visit Vinh Trang Pagoda, the biggest pagoda (multi-tiered Buddhist temple tower) of the Mekong Delta, before you set sail on a boat ride along the Mekong River. Explore My Tho, the floating market city of Vietnam, and Tortoise Islet during the ride. After the fun-filled day, you will be transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
